name: kittex
description: Shows the LaTeX math in Claude's replies as real equations: images in kitty and Ghostty, text elsewhere

block.title: Block math
block.description: Equations on their own line ($$…$$): image (typeset; Unicode in terminals without images), unicode (Unicode text) or raw (Claude's LaTeX as written).

inline.title: Inline math
inline.description: Math inside a sentence ($…$): image, unicode or raw (same meanings).
